title: Akbar Ka Matam Hai Asghar Ka Matam Hai
body:
Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
Zahra Ke Piyare Ko Rone Ka Mausam Hai
Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Piyaase Shaheedo’n Ke Purse Ko Aaye Hai’n
Aa’nkho’n Mei’n Ashko’n ke Nazrane Laaye Hai’n
Har Dil Hai Gham Se Choor Har Chashm Purnam Hai
Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maatam Hai Har Ghar Mei’n Mazloom Sarwar Ka
Jaan e Payambar Ka Zahra Ke Dilbar Ka
Rote Hai’n Ehle Dil Maahe Moharram Hai
Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kadiyal Jawa’n Akbar Kis Tarha Tadpe The
Unke Liye Sarwra Kis Tarha Tadpe The
Phir Yaad Aaya Hai , Phir Aankh Purnam Hai
Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Be Tarha Piyaso’n Ko Tadpata Hai Besheer
Peete Hai’n Jab Paani Yaad Aata Hai Besheer
Chhalki Sabeelo’n Par Mehshar Ka Aalam Hai
Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ab Behte Paani Par Pehra Nahi Lekin
Akbar Ka Dil Tute Sadyaa’n Huwi’n Lekin
Thamte Nahi’n Aa’nsu Who Dard e Paiham Hai
Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Shabbir Ka Gham Hai Khatoon e Mehshar Ka
Ajr e Risalat Hai Haq Hai Payambar Ka
Duniya Ke Har Gham Par Ye Gham Muqaddam Hai
Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Seena Fighaar Apna Gham Pur Wiqaar Apna
Hai Sunnat e Sajjad Ab Tak Shiaar Apna
Hatho’n Mei’n Zanjeere’n Kaa’ndhe Pe Parcham Hai
Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Maloom Ka Gham Hai Jaise Lahoo Dil Mei’n
Jab Tak Dhadakne Ki Hai Aarzoo Dil Mei’n
Us Waqt Tak Manzoor Sarwar Ka Matam Hai
Akbar ka matam hai , Asghar ka matam hai
